Howdy all,


We’ve rolled out WP Workbench 2.0.9 plugin for all Virtualmin Pro users.


Changes since 2.0.8:


- Add error handling for a corrupt cache data file
- Fix not to trigger the add and delete domain API unless the script is supported


Changes since 2.0.7:


- Fix to add config option to open links in the new tab
